# Adding, Editing and Removing Staff

This article walks through the day-to-day jobs on the **User Management** page: adding someone, changing their details, issuing and resetting PINs, turning access on and off, and removing people who have left.

You'll find it at **Settings → User Management**. Only an **Organization Admin** can make changes here.

---

## Adding a member of staff

Press **Add Staff** at the top right. You'll be asked to choose one of two routes.

### Add staff with OrderHub login

*For managers and anyone who needs to access OrderHub on the web. They'll sign in with a 6-digit code sent to their email.*

1. Press **Continue** on that card.
2. Fill in **Full name** and **Email**.
3. Choose their **OrderHub role** — **Organization Admin** or **Organization User**.
4. If they also work the till, turn on **POS access** and choose their **POS role**.
5. Turn on **Film App access** if they work in the film room.
6. Press **Create staff**.

* Note: If you turned on POS access or Film App access, a 4-digit PIN is generated and shown once on the next screen. Copy it and give it to them directly — you won't see it in that banner again.
* Note: If you didn't turn either on, they simply get an invite at that email address.

### Add POS-only staff

*For counter staff who only use OrderHub POS at the till. No email needed — they'll sign in with a PIN.*

1. Press **Continue** on that card.
2. Fill in **Full name**.
3. Choose their **POS role**.
4. Turn on **Film App access** if they also work in the film room.
5. Press **Create staff**.

A 4-digit PIN is generated when you save and shown once on the next screen.

![Add Staff](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/46527ebe-2947-48cd-b55b-ed0e6c9bbbe0.png)

---

## Finding someone

The chips at the top of the list filter by access: **All staff**, **Web access** and **POS only**. Below that you can search by name or email, and filter by role with **All Roles**, **Organization Admin** and **Organization User**.

---

## Editing a member of staff

Everything below is done on the person's card in the list.

### Changing their name

Press the pencil next to their name, type the new name and save.

### Changing their location

Next to **Location**, press the map pin and choose a site. This decides which site their work is attributed to, and for labs with more than one processing site it controls which film rolls they may update.

### Changing their POS role

The **POS Role** dropdown appears once POS access is on. Pick the new role — it saves straight away.

* Note: *Applies on the staff member's next PIN sign-in at the till.*

### Their PIN

The **POS PIN** on the card shows their current 4-digit PIN.

* The circular arrow **resets** the PIN. A new one is generated and shown immediately; the old one stops working at once.
* The **Enable** button issues a PIN and turns on till access for someone who doesn't have one.
* The power button **turns off POS access**. You'll be asked to confirm.

### Film App access

The **Film App** switch turns the Film Development App on or off for that person. They sign in on the lab's film tablet with the same PIN.

* Note: The two are independent. Turning off POS access leaves Film App access on and the person keeps their PIN. Turning both off removes the PIN.

![Staff Cards](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/d908b54e-a57f-4c4e-b8fd-7caaf5fd04ed.png)

---

## Resending the welcome email

Staff with an email address have a **Resend Welcome Email** button on their card. Use it if someone never received their original invitation. POS-only staff don't have one — they sign in with a PIN, not an email.

---

## Seeing what someone has done

Press **View Activity** on their card to open their history in place. Press **Hide Activity** to close it again.

---

## Removing someone

**Delete** removes the person permanently and cannot be undone. You'll be asked to confirm.

Use it only for people who have genuinely left. If someone is away, has changed job, or you simply want to stop them using the till, turn off their access instead — their history stays intact either way, but deleting also removes the person from your list.

---

## Summary of Best Practices

* Decide which of the two routes fits the person before you start — a POS-only member of staff cannot be given a web login later without being added again.
* Copy the PIN the moment it appears. If you lose it, reset it rather than guessing.
* Reset the PIN whenever someone leaves the counter team or you think the PIN has been seen by others.
* Turn off access rather than deleting when someone is temporarily away.
* Set a **Location** for everyone working in a specific shop or lab, especially if you process film at more than one site.
